description: Write the evidence matrix, GO decision table and pocket comparison table artifacts, and plot the measured carboxylate-anchor distances against DCAR-1 pocket conservation
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os, json
# ---------- artifact 1: evidence matrix ----------
EM=[
 dict(citation="PMID:25086774", evidence_type="mutant phenotype + direct assay",
  stance="supports premise", claim="DCAR-1 is required for the epidermal response to fungal infection and wounding, and HPLA is its endogenous ligand",
  key_finding="Genome-wide RNAi screen identified DCAR-1; it acts in the epidermis to regulate antimicrobial peptide expression via p38 MAPK; targeted metabolomics identified 4-hydroxyphenyllactic acid as the endogenous ligand",
  context="C. elegans, epidermis, in vivo RNAi and nlp-29 reporter; ligand identified by metabolomics and applied exogenously",
  confidence="High for the genetic requirement, moderate for direct receptor-ligand engagement; no binding assay, no purified receptor, no structure"),
 dict(citation="PDB 8IJA (HCAR2 + niacin), 8IHJ (HCAR3 + acifran), 9JKT (HCAR3 + D-phenyllactate)",
  evidence_type="structural (contacts recomputed here from deposited coordinates)",
  stance="defines the reference", claim="HCAR-family receptors anchor the ligand carboxylate with Arg3.36 and hydrogen bond it with Tyr7.43",
  key_finding="Measured directly: 8IJA R111 2.72 A, Y284 2.61 A; 9JKT R111 2.83 A, Y284 2.90 A; 8IHJ R111 2.62 A. HCAR3 pocket volume 75 A3 with the ligand removed, 100% ligand-atom recovery by the cavity detector",
  context="Human HCAR2/HCAR3 cryo-EM complexes",
  confidence="High. These are the correct comparators: 9JKT ligand HF2 (D-phenyllactate) is the des-hydroxy analogue of HPLA"),
 dict(citation="This analysis (AlphaFold AF-G5EDI0-v6 + GPCRdb generic numbering)",
  evidence_type="computational structural",
  stance="refutes", claim="DCAR-1 carries an HCAR-like carboxylate-binding Arg3.36 and Tyr7.43",
  key_finding="DCAR-1 has Phe at 3.36 (F120) and Phe at 7.43 (F302). No basic residue sits at any anchor position used by acid receptors (3.29, 3.33, 3.36, 5.39, 6.58, 7.35, 7.39). TM3 register confirmed twice: GPCRdb offset resi-BWindex = 84 at six TM3 anchors, and F116 superposes on HCAR3 F107 at 1.30 A",
  context="Predicted model, pLDDT 87-94 in the pocket region",
  confidence="High for the residue identities, moderate for the exact BW register of TM7 (a one-residue shift would change which TM7 face lines the pocket)"),
 dict(citation="This analysis (UniRef50_G5EDI0, 18 nematode homologues)",
  evidence_type="evolutionary",
  stance="refutes", claim="A carboxylate-binding basic residue at 3.36 is conserved in nematode DCAR-1 orthologues",
  key_finding="3.36 is Phe in 17/18 and never basic; 7.43 is F/A/T and never Tyr. 58-94% identity, Caenorhabditis spp., Diploscapter pachys, Heligmosomoides polygyrus, Angiostrongylus costaricensis",
  context="Sequence only; UniRef50 cluster membership used because the EBI BLAST REST endpoint refused new jobs",
  confidence="High for the C. elegans group, lower outside it because the cluster is dominated by Caenorhabditis"),
 dict(citation="This analysis (BW superposition of AF-G5EDI0 on 9JKT, ligand transfer)",
  evidence_type="computational structural",
  stance="qualifies", claim="DCAR-1 has no basic residue facing the orthosteric space at all",
  key_finding="R300 (7.41) is invariant in 18/18 homologues and lies 0.85 A from the transferred ligand centroid, salt-bridged to E113 (3.29, Glu in 17/18) at 2.56 A. The ligand position itself is 1.33 A from protein atoms, that is, occluded in the apo model",
  context="Predicted model, pLDDT 90.9 (E113) and 93.8 (R300)",
  confidence="Moderate. The pair is a model-derived feature; apo models routinely close pockets, so this is a hypothesis for mutagenesis, not a demonstrated ligand contact"),
 dict(citation="This analysis (negative controls)",
  evidence_type="computational",
  stance="qualifies", claim="Fold-level similarity can assign DCAR-1 to a ligand class",
  key_finding="Identity to all references 18-26% (rhodopsin 25.9%); TM-bundle RMSD 1.29-1.81 A for acid and peptide receptors alike; apo AlphaFold cavity volumes do not track ligand size (HCAR2 460, HCAR3 337, GHSR 648, NTSR1 448 A3)",
  context="Ten reference structures, four apo control models",
  confidence="High. These measures are uninformative here and must not be used to justify a GO call"),
 dict(citation="PANTHER PTHR24243 (database-level, via UniProt cross-reference)",
  evidence_type="review/database",
  stance="competing", claim="DCAR-1 is a small-molecule acid receptor",
  key_finding="PTHR24243 human members are peptide receptors (NTSR1, NTSR2, NMUR1, NMUR2, CCKBR, MLNR, GHSR); C. elegans members include dcar-1 with nmur-1/2/3, npr-21, npr-35, sphr-1. Best pairwise hit for DCAR-1 is C. elegans NMUR-1 at 30.8%",
  context="Family assignment by HMM, the basis of the existing IBA neuropeptide receptor activity annotation",
  confidence="Moderate. Family membership does not fix ligand class, and it conflicts with the HPLA genetics"),
 dict(citation="This analysis (class A motif audit)",
  evidence_type="computational structural",
  stance="qualifies", claim="DCAR-1 is a canonical class A GPCR whose pocket can be read off a human template",
  key_finding="Keeps D2.50 (D84), W4.50 (W161), P6.50 (P268), D7.49-P7.50 (D310-P311); lacks D(E)RY (L133-K134-L135), CWxP Trp (6.48 = M266, Asn in 12/18 homologues) and NPxxY Tyr (7.53 = A314). Model predicts C9-C283 and C189-C194, not C3.25-C45.50",
  context="Sequence and AlphaFold model",
  confidence="High for the motif calls. Divergence this deep limits how far any human template transfers"),
]
em=pd.DataFrame(EM); em.to_csv("evidence_matrix.csv",index=False)

# ---------- artifact 2: GO decision table ----------
GO=[
 dict(go_id="GO:0004930", term="G protein-coupled receptor activity", aspect="MF",
   current_or_candidate="retain", recommended_action="retain",
   evidence_basis="Seven-TM fold with D2.50, W4.50, P6.50, D7.49-P7.50 intact; TM bundle superposes on ten class A receptors at 1.29-1.81 A; PMID:25086774 genetics place it upstream of a p38 pathway",
   confidence="high"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0008528", term="G protein-coupled peptide receptor activity", aspect="MF",
   current_or_candidate="existing IBA (neuropeptide receptor activity, GO:0008188, related)", recommended_action="do not strengthen; flag as family-inferred only",
   evidence_basis="Rests entirely on PANTHER PTHR24243 membership. No peptide ligand reported for DCAR-1; the only reported ligand (PMID:25086774) is a tyrosine metabolite",
   confidence="low"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0001637 / GO:0070553-type", term="hydroxycarboxylic acid receptor activity or a small-acid receptor child", aspect="MF",
   current_or_candidate="candidate implied by the seed hypothesis", recommended_action="do not add",
   evidence_basis="No basic residue at 3.29/3.33/3.36/5.39/6.58/7.35/7.39; 3.36 Phe in 17/18 nematode homologues; 7.43 never Tyr. Fold and pocket-volume measures shown to be non-discriminating",
   confidence="high for the negative"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0045087 / GO:0002376 branch", term="innate immune response (epidermal antimicrobial peptide induction)", aspect="BP",
   current_or_candidate="supported by primary literature", recommended_action="retain, with IMP from PMID:25086774",
   evidence_basis="RNAi loss of dcar-1 blocks nlp-29-class antimicrobial peptide induction after fungal infection and wounding",
   confidence="high"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0005886", term="plasma membrane", aspect="CC",
   current_or_candidate="candidate", recommended_action="retain or add as IC from the receptor activity",
   evidence_basis="Seven-TM topology; functions cell-autonomously in the epidermis (PMID:25086774). No direct localization image cited",
   confidence="moderate"),
 dict(go_id="GO:0005515", term="protein binding", aspect="MF",
   current_or_candidate="not recommended", recommended_action="avoid",
   evidence_basis="Uninformative for this receptor; no interaction dataset was used here",
   confidence="n/a"),
]
go=pd.DataFrame(GO); go.to_csv("go_decision_table.csv",index=False)

# ---------- artifact 3: pocket comparison table ----------
PC=pd.DataFrame({
 "BW position":["2.60","2.64","3.28","3.29","3.32","3.33","3.36","5.39","6.48","6.58","7.35","7.39","7.41","7.43"],
 "role in acid receptors":["pocket floor","pocket wall","pocket wall","anchor in SUCNR1/OXGR1","aromatic wall",
   "anchor in OXGR1","carboxylate anchor in HCAR1-3","anchor in FFAR1-3","toggle switch","anchor in GPR35",
   "anchor in FFAR2","anchor in SUCNR1/OXGR1","not an anchor","carboxylate H-bond in HCAR1-3"],
 "HCAR2":["Y87(2.64 Y)","Y","V","L","F","A","R111","-","W","-","-","L280","S","Y284"],
 "HCAR3":["V83","Y86/Y87","V103","L104","F107","A108","R111","-","W","-","-","L280","S","Y284"],
 "DCAR-1":["T94","V98","I112","E113","F116","I117","F120","-","M266","-","R294 (faces lipid)","C298","R300","F302"],
 "DCAR-1 conservation (n=18)":["18/18 T","18/18 V","18/18 I","17/18 E","17/18 F","18/18 I","17/18 F","-",
   "12/18 N, 2/18 M","-","not pocket-facing","18/18 C","18/18 R","13/18 F, 3/18 A, 2/18 T"],
})
PC.to_csv("pocket_comparison_table.csv",index=False)

for f in ["evidence_matrix.csv","go_decision_table.csv","pocket_comparison_table.csv"]:
    print(f, os.path.getsize(f), "bytes")
print()
print(PC.to_string(index=False))

# ---------- summary figure, all values computed in earlier cells of this job ----------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14,5))
lbl=["HCAR2 R111\n(8IJA, niacin)","HCAR3 R111\n(9JKT, D-phenyllactate)","HCAR3 R111\n(8IHJ, acifran)",
     "HCAR2 Y284\n(8IJA)","HCAR3 Y284\n(9JKT)","DCAR-1 F120 (3.36)\nno H-bond donor","DCAR-1 F302 (7.43)\nno H-bond donor"]
val=[2.72,2.83,2.62,2.61,2.90,np.nan,np.nan]
col=["#1f77b4"]*3+["#9467bd"]*2+["#7f7f7f"]*2
b=ax[0].bar(range(7),[v if not np.isnan(v) else 0 for v in val],color=col)
for i,v in enumerate(val):
    ax[0].text(i, (v if not np.isnan(v) else 0.1)+0.08, "absent" if np.isnan(v) else f"{v:.2f}", ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xticks(range(7));ax[0].set_xticklabels(lbl,fontsize=7.5)
ax[0].set_ylabel("shortest contact to the ligand carboxylate (A)")
ax[0].set_title("Carboxylate anchors measured in deposited structures, and the DCAR-1 equivalents")
ax[0].set_ylim(0,3.6);ax[0].grid(axis="y",alpha=.3)
cons=pd.DataFrame({"pos":["3.29 E113","3.32 F116","3.36 F120","6.48 M266","7.41 R300","7.43 F302"],
                   "pct":[17/18*100,17/18*100,17/18*100,2/18*100,100.0,13/18*100],
                   "kind":["acidic","aromatic","aromatic","toggle","basic","aromatic"]})
cmap={"acidic":"#d62728","aromatic":"#7f7f7f","basic":"#2ca02c","toggle":"#ff7f0e"}
ax[1].bar(cons.pos,cons.pct,color=[cmap[k] for k in cons.kind])
ax[1].set_ylabel("% of 18 nematode homologues with the C. elegans residue")
ax[1].set_title("Conservation of DCAR-1 pocket positions\n(green basic, red acidic, grey aromatic, orange 6.48 toggle)")
ax[1].set_ylim(0,105);ax[1].tick_params(axis="x",labelsize=8);ax[1].grid(axis="y",alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
